descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S05 12 h expiry in both modes: present at 11 h, really deleted at 13 h, not restarted by Save Note, editor open/close or import

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Points expire 12 h after they were written; a point checked 13 h after it was written is gone (Hospital 3.6: Important Points 12 h; TC-12 step 6 repeats it in Nursing Home). … (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.6; TFA-92590 AC 6; TFA-94699 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T2 The 12 h Important Points window clears as a real deletion (queryable as gone), not a hidden flag; the window is a configuration value and the purge runs on the server. (TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-94699 AC 7; UAT 3.6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T3 A deleted Important Point never comes back unless the physician enters it again. (TFA-94699 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital patients H1-H7 and Nursing Home residents N1-N4, each with one point written at T0 by server time (H4 / N3 also get a second point at T0+11 h)

When H1 / N1: check at T0+11 h and T0+13 h. H2 / N2: Save Note at T0+11 h. H3: nobody opens the app; server-side read at T0+13 h. H4 / N3: a second point P2 added at T0+11 h. H5 / N4: the editor opened and closed without typing at T0+11 h. H6: Previous Notes > Paste > Save & Extract at T0+11 h. …

Then 11 h: the point is shown and stored. 13 h: gone from the panel and from the database. Hospital: rounding:get importantPoints == [] and importantPointsDraft == ''. Nursing Home: the raw snfResidents doc has importantPoints empty, importantPointsDraft == '' and no admissionSummary.importantPoints. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-12 steps 5-6 and TFA-92590 AC 6 '12 h after they were written'; TFA-94699 AC 1 'queryable as gone' (the raw fields above, not only snf:get), AC 5 (an expired point does not come back from the draft or the editor's copy), AC 7 'purge on the server'. …

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92590 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

A Hospital Important Point written 13 h ago is still stored and still shown in the pre-round editor: main clears points at 18 h, and Save Note, a prior-note import or opening the editor restart the clock. Nursing Home points never expire.

Evidence: allure 1f69e1d4: all 8 failed cells are known K1 (OAT-04 knownGaps: an 18 h window and one list clock maxed with notesProcessedAt). The NH cells are recorded under TC-12 Q1 / K14. Owners are TFA-92590 AC 6 and TFA-94699 AC 1/2/7, both in progress. The matrix ticket note from Quinn's 10-09 audit lists the same.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane retention.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: retention.

12 h expiry in both modes: present at 11 h, really deleted at 13 h, not restarted by Save Note, editor open/close or import

Tickets: TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane retention: status failed in retention/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (retention/plan.json, automatable: yes): Browser + API: H1-H7 and N1-N4 each with one point written at T0 through the editor; legs at T0+11 h (Save Note live AI, editor open/close with the clocks read before and after, second point, prior-note paste + Save & Extract live AI, editor left open); checks at 11 h and 13 h on raw rows; H3 read with no client purge; N1 editor + Save Note after 13 h. Every Save Note waits for a NEW notesProcessedAt (or preRoundError) with the page kept on the chart; a leg whose Save Note or import did not finish is blocked and its cell not judged. NH cells recorded (Fail not final until Q1). 4 Save Notes + 1 import as the scenario names them (about 21 model requests, counted in the evidence). — All legs are UI actions plus clock moves; about 6 live AI calls.

Where it ran: local

H5 at 13 h fails on K1 either way. The first run's N1 / N2 / H7 Save Notes never finished (page left 4 s after the click, wait accepted a missing notesProcessedAt); in this run all four Save Notes and the import finished before the next step (H2/N2/H7/N1 notesProcessedAt in the snapshots).

Every leg fails on the 18 h window alone (K1). On top of that, the Save Note, the import and a plain open-and-close of the editor each restart the points clock (closeEditor saves ptsEditedAt = now, PreRoundNotesCard.tsx:168; seen here when the page stays on the chart, lost when the physician leaves at once), which TFA-94699 AC 2 forbids. Breaks UAT TC-12 steps 5-6, TFA-92590 AC 6 and TFA-94699 AC 1 / 2 / 5 / 7. Known in the matrix: K1.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Aging the points to 11 h and 13 h needs the aging helper and a server-clock control, plus admin reads of the raw rounding / snfResidents rows, all through the local stack's admin key; dev has no admin key and its server clock cannot be moved, so this stays on the local stack (when the helper exis…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
